topic: 'Excellent for mind,body and spirit': Participant, facilitator, and community stakeholder experiences of Music and Movement for Health

sources.title: 'Excellent for mind,body and spirit': Participant, facilitator, and community stakeholder experiences of Music and Movement for Health
sources.authors: O'Malley N, O'Reilly S, Byrne S, Cheung PS, Fitzell C, NiBhriain O, Moss H, Gowran RJ, Louw Q, Woods C, O'Neill D, Glynn L, Cavanagh M, Maher C, Salsberg J, Tha

findings.finding: Participants valued the combination of music and dance within the arts-based intervention.
findings.quote: MMH was viewed as a unique arts-based intervention that combined participants' interest in music and dance and had many perceived physical and psychological benefits.

findings.finding: The intervention successfully offered routine and valuable social opportunities following the pandemic.
findings.quote: Additionally, MMH provided routine and social opportunities to older adults, which were particularly valued in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic.

findings.finding: Delivering exercise through the arts made the activity enjoyable and desirable for older adults.
findings.quote: The provision of exercise through the arts was enjoyable and, resultantly, desirable to many older adults, with perceived positive physical and psychosocial outcomes.

principle: Combining music, movement, and arts-based group activities provides enjoyable health promotion, social connection, and routine for older adults.
for_the_teacher: Combine music and movement into an enjoyable arts-based experience to foster physical and psychological benefits.
Provide consistent routines that offer participants a reliable structure and social opportunities.
